# Deep Tutor Pro {{VERSION}}

Deep Tutor Pro {{VERSION}} is a design and accessibility update. Your data, sync and backups are unchanged from 2.0.

## What’s new

- **New Home screen.** It suggests your next steps: import a curriculum, finish unit outlines, write missing notes, review draft papers, approve draft notes and add students. It also shows notes coverage for each course unit and your recent work.
- **Search everything.** Press **Ctrl + K** (or **⌘ K**), or use the search button in the header, to jump to any screen, programme, unit, topic, note, paper, class or student.
- **Formatting toolbar for notes.** Add headings, bold, italic, bullet and numbered lists, quotes, tables and source tags. **Ctrl + B** and **Ctrl + I** work while you type.
- **Marks charts.** Each marks sheet shows how final marks are spread, with the pass mark marked on the chart, and the class average for each assessment component. Every chart has hover details and a text description for screen readers.
- **Easier to read.** Text and buttons meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in both dark and light themes, links are underlined, and status colours are readable in light mode. The app uses the Inter typeface, bundled so it works offline.
- **Better on phones.** Nothing overflows sideways on small screens, and the bottom navigation now has short labels (Home, Units, Notes, Marks, Solve).
- **Keyboard and screen readers.** Focus outlines are visible, form fields have labels, targets are larger, and animations stop when your device asks for reduced motion.

An automated check of 20 screens on desktop and phone, in dark and light themes, found no WCAG 2.2 AA violations (204 before this release) and no horizontal overflow (5 screens before).

## Downloads

| `Deep-Tutor-Pro-{{VERSION}}-Android.apk` | Android 7.0 or later (install from file) |
| `deep-tutor-pro-web-{{VERSION}}.zip` | Web build: unzip and serve the folder from any static web server |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums for the files above |

## Notes

- To upgrade, install over 2.0. Your work stays on the device.
- AI-generated notes and papers are still marked as drafts on exports until you approve them.
